decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Prior approval for siting and appearance is required.
Reason: The development requires prior approval for its siting and appearance as the site is located in a sensitive and highly visible area, it being within land designated as Metropolitan Open Land (MOL) and adjacent to Grove Park Conservation Area, affecting the setting of the Conservation Area, while the site itself is elevated above the surrounding land, and exposed.

Condition : 2 - 1.	The development would, by reason its excessive height and location on an elevated bridge approach within Metropolitan Open Land, and addition of additional cabinets adjacent to the open highway, detract from the from the openness and views in the locality, and would adversely affect the special character of the Metropolitan Open Land. This would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.1.7 Telecommunications, ENV-N.1.5 Protection of Metropolitan Open Land and ENV-W.1.1 Design in the Thames Policy Area, of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 (UDP) and the UDP Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 3 - 2.	The development would, by reason its excessive height and location on an elevated bridge approach and addition of additional cabinets, detract from the from the openness and views from the adjacent Grove Park Conservation Area, and so it would fail to preserve or enhance the appearance and character of Grove Park Conservation Area, and would adversely affect setting of the Conservation Area. This would be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.1.7 Telecommunications, and ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 (UDP) and the UDP Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Installation of radio base station comprising a 12.5m high telecommunication slimline monopole containing three shrouded antennas, one node B equipment cabinet and development ancillary thereto
